info.title: Worlds API
info.description: Data-plane API for Wazoo Worlds — search, SPARQL, import, export, and World lifecycle.

id.description: Immutable World ID minted by Worlds API as `w_<ULID>`.

displayName.description: User-facing display name for the world. Set on creation or update.

state.description: Lifecycle state: active, deleted, or suspended. Deleted worlds enter a 30-day grace period before permanent purge.

storage.description: Storage backend for the world. All worlds share a single Cloudflare D1 database, separated by world_id.

embeddingModel.description: Embedding model identifier used for vector search indexing, e.g. openai/text-embedding-3-small or openrouter/openai/text-embedding-3-small. Values outside the allowlist (including the legacy tfjs-universal-sentence-encoder default) are reported as embeddingStatus unconfigured and search stays keyword-only.

embeddingStatus.description: Whether vector search is usable for this world. unconfigured: embeddings are not enabled or the model is not allowlisted. no_credential: the namespace has no active embedding credential for the provider of this world's model. invalid: the provider rejected the namespace credential. stale: vectors are not built for the current model; search is keyword-only until POST /worlds/{worldId}/reindex. partial: some vectors failed to sync; hybrid search covers what exists. ready: vectors are current.

chunkSize.description: Maximum number of RDF quads per chunk when indexing for vector search.

topK.description: Default number of top search results to return when the caller does not override.

minScore.description: Default minimum relevance score (0–1) for search results. Results below this threshold are omitted.

createTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the world was created.

updateTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the world was last updated.

deleteTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the world was soft-deleted. Null if not deleted.

expireTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the world will be permanently purged after the grace period. Null if not scheduled for purge.

enabled.description: Opt the world in to OWL 2 RL materialization on write. false is the same as never setting it.

graphs.description: Named-graph mode. per-graph (default) lists each entailed quad in the graph(s) that entail it alone; union merges all graphs and lists everything in the default graph.

maxAssertedQuads.description: Size guard (default 100000). A commit that would exceed this many asserted quads fails before writing instead of exhausting the isolate.

InferenceSetting.description: OWL 2 RL inference setting. Omitted when never configured, which means inference is off.

displayName.description: User-facing display name for the new world.

embeddingModel.description: Embedding model to use for vector search, as provider/model. Allowlist: openai/text-embedding-3-small (recommended), openai/text-embedding-3-large (pinned to 1536 dimensions), legacy openai/text-embedding-ada-002, and the same OpenAI models through OpenRouter as openrouter/openai/text-embedding-3-small and openrouter/openai/text-embedding-3-large. The model's provider decides which namespace credential is used. Defaults to the platform default, which reports embeddingStatus unconfigured until a model is chosen.

chunkSize.description: Maximum quads per chunk for vector search indexing. Defaults to the platform default.

topK.description: Default number of top results for search queries against this world.

minScore.description: Default minimum relevance score (0–1) for search results in this world.

allOf.description: Opt the world in to OWL 2 RL inference. Off when omitted. The data plane additionally needs the quads.derived column before enabling.

displayName.description: New display name for the world.

embeddingModel.description: New embedding model, as provider/model. Requires an active embedding credential, for the new model's provider, in the namespace. Changing the model marks the world stale (embeddingStatus stale): search is keyword-only until POST /worlds/{worldId}/reindex is called. It does not reindex automatically because reindexing spends the customer's provider budget.

chunkSize.description: New chunk size for vector search indexing.

topK.description: New default top-K for search queries.

minScore.description: New default minimum score threshold for search results.

allOf.description: Replaces the world's inference setting. Enabling does not back-fill existing data: inferred quads appear only for later changes.

worlds.description: Worlds of the namespace whose vectors were cleaned.

incomplete.description: True when vectors remain (a failure, or more than one request can remove). Calling the endpoint again is safe and continues; the purge sweep retries too.

quads.description: Number of RDF quads successfully imported.

chunks.description: Number of vector search chunks created from the imported quads.

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. NOT_FOUND, INVALID_ARGUMENT, RATE_LIMITED.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong.

data.description: RDF payload to import. The format must match the contentType field.

contentType.description: MIME type of the import payload. Supported values: text/turtle, application/trig, application/n-triples, application/n-quads, text/n3, application/json (quad rows), text/plain or application/x-ndjson (text chunks). Defaults to text/turtle.

nextOffset.description: Offset for the next page. Omit this field when there are no more results.

object.description: RDF object URI or literal value.

graph.description: Named graph URI. Null when the quad belongs to the default graph.

mode.description: Search mode that actually ran: keyword (full-text), semantic (vector), hybrid (both), or fallback (LIKE) when the primary engine is unavailable.

id.description: Stable deterministic identifier for the matched quad and text (shared across backends), used for ranked-list evaluation and deduplication.

subject.description: RDF subject URI identifying the matched resource, e.g. https://example.org/entity/42.

predicate.description: RDF predicate URI describing the relationship, e.g. http://schema.org/name.

graph.description: Named graph URI the quad belongs to. Absent when the world uses a default graph.

content.description: Text content of the matched quad, used for display and snippet generation. The single text field replacing the legacy object field.

score.description: Relevance score from the search engine on the normalized 0–1 scale (1.0 = best). Null for fallback LIKE search results.

scoreType.description: Scoring family the score expresses: rrf (reciprocal rank fusion, normalized), cosine (vector similarity), or unranked (fallback results carry no ordering meaning).

query.description: Natural language or keyword search query to find matching content in the world.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–100). Defaults to 20. The response is capped at this value after ranking; the engine's internal candidate pool is at least this large.

minScore.description: Override the world's minimum relevance score on the normalized 0–1 scale (1.0 = best). Results below this threshold are omitted after ranking.

subjects.description: Only match quads whose subject is in this list. Applied before ranking.

predicates.description: Only match quads whose predicate is in this list. Applied before ranking.

graphs.description: Only match quads whose graph is in this list. Applied before ranking.

include.description: Include allowlist: only quads matching these exact subject/predicate/graph values are candidates.

subjects.description: Exclude quads whose subject is in this list. Applied before ranking.

predicates.description: Exclude quads whose predicate is in this list. Applied before ranking.

graphs.description: Exclude quads whose graph is in this list. Applied before ranking.

exclude.description: Exclude denylist: quads matching these exact subject/predicate/graph values are not candidates.

SearchFilter.description: Include/exclude quad filters applied before ranking (SDK QuadFilter semantics).

query.description: SPARQL 1.1 query string. Supports SELECT, ASK, and SPARQL UPDATE (INSERT/DELETE). SELECT results are limited by the server-configured maximum.

uid.description: Unique identifier for the created API key.

token.description: The full bearer token (wzw format). Displayed once on creation — store it securely.

namespace.description: Namespace the key is scoped to.

worldId.description: World ID the key is scoped to, or null if the key has namespace-wide access.

createTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the key was created.

namespace.description: Namespace to scope the API key to. Required. The key can only access worlds within this namespace.

worldId.description: Optional world ID to scope the key to a single world. Omit to allow access to all worlds in the namespace.

name.description: Human-readable label for the key. Helps identify keys in the list.

scopes.description: Optional scope grant. Defaults to ["data:read", "data:write"]. Use ["data:read"] for read-only keys. embeddings:admin grants management of the namespace embedding credential and is never part of the default grant.

uid.description: Unique identifier for the API key.

namespace.description: Namespace the key is scoped to.

worldId.description: World ID the key is scoped to, or absent for namespace-wide keys.

createTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the key was created.

providers.description: One entry per provider the namespace has stored a credential for, newest first, revoked ones included.

status.description: active: usable. invalid: the provider rejected the key repeatedly; rotate it. revoked: deleted; worlds fall back to keyword-only search.

fingerprint.description: First 8 hex characters of the key's SHA-256, for support.

last4.description: Last four characters of the key.

rotateTime.description: ISO 8601 time of the most recent rotation.

revokeTime.description: ISO 8601 time the credential was revoked.

apiKey.description: The provider API key. Write-only: it is encrypted at rest and never returned or logged; only a fingerprint and last four characters are exposed.

post.description: Always returns 400. Use POST /worlds/{worldId}/sparql to execute a SPARQL query against a specific world.

Execute a SPARQL 1.1 query (SELECT, ASK, or UPDATE) against a world's RDF graph. SELECT and ASK require the data:read scope; SPARQL UPDATE (INSERT, DELETE, CLEAR, DROP, and the other update forms) requires data:write, and a key without it receives 403 before the update runs. An unparseable query returns 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT. SELECT results are limited by the server-configured maximum. Queries time out after the configured limit.

post.description: Rebuild the vector and full-text search indexes for a world from its stored RDF quads. Required after changing the embedding model (the world is stale and search is keyword-only until it completes) and useful to repair search quality. The full-text index is always rebuilt from D1; if any vector could not be embedded, written or cleaned up, status is completed_with_vector_errors and vectorSync says what failed. Rerunning reindex repairs it. Embedding spend is checked against the namespace's daily write budget first; an exhausted budget returns 429 EMBEDDING_BUDGET_EXCEEDED. Worlds with more text than EMBEDDING_REINDEX_MAX_CHUNKS are reindexed in windows across several calls: each call embeds only the next window, so no chunk is embedded twice and the world becomes ready when the last window completes.

schema.description: The world-api-minted world ID, a w_ prefix and a lowercase ULID.

parameters.description: The world-api-minted world ID, a w_ prefix and a lowercase ULID.
parameters.name: worldId

200.description: Reindex ran. status is completed, completed_with_vector_errors when the vector index could not be fully synced (see vectorSync; calling again retries the failed window), or in_progress when a large world is reindexed in windows: call again until completed (continuation.remainingChunksEstimate says how much is left).

429.description: The namespace's daily embedding budget is exhausted (EMBEDDING_BUDGET_EXCEEDED). Nothing was reindexed or spent.

post.summary: Back-fill inference for a world's existing data
post.description: Materializes OWL 2 RL inference for data a world already holds. Enabling inference on a world only reacts to later writes; call this once afterwards to cover what is stored. It reads the world's asserted quads, runs the reasoner once, clears the world's inferred quads and writes the closure. Asserted quads are never changed. It is idempotent and safe to repeat; a failure part way leaves some inferred quads, so call it again. The world must have inference enabled. A world larger than its maxAssertedQuads limit is refused before any write (422 INFERENCE_SIZE_GUARD).

get.description: Lists the namespace's embedding provider credentials, newest first, revoked ones included so their status stays readable. Metadata only: no key is ever returned. Requires the embeddings:admin scope.

200.description: Credential metadata, one entry per provider

put.description: Store or rotate the namespace's API key for one embedding provider (bring your own key). The key is encrypted at rest with a key held only as a Worker secret and is write-only: it is never returned or logged. Requires the embeddings:admin scope (or an admin key); world-scoped tokens are refused. Returns 503 EMBEDDINGS_NOT_CONFIGURED when the deployment has no key-encryption key.

delete.description: Revokes the namespace's credential for one provider: the ciphertext is erased and worlds on that provider's models fall back to keyword-only search (embeddingStatus no_credential). Every world on that provider's models is marked stale (worlds on another provider's models are untouched), so after a new key is set search stays keyword-only until each world is reindexed (vectors built before the revoke are never trusted again). Requires the embeddings:admin scope.
